qualification.details: Senior Cyber Security Consultant: Bachelor's in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field with 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity engineering, security operations, incident response, threat detection, and vulnerability management. Working knowledge of ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, NIST frameworks. Core technical skills in SIEM/SOAR, XDR/EDR, firewalls, WAF, cloud security (AWS, Azure, GCP), Zero-Trust, scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell), containerization.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Madras Senior Cyber Security Consultant Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Madras to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Senior Cyber Security Consultant position at IIT Madras?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Senior Cyber Security Consultant role at IIT Madras is September 7, 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field to be eligible for the Senior Cyber Security Consultant position.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by IIT Madras.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Cyber Security Consultant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Cyber Security Consultant position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 166,667.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Cyber Security Consultant post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Senior Cyber Security Consultant position in this recruitment drive by IIT Madras.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for the Senior Cyber Security Consultant position at IIT Madras is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website or the provided link.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates, followed by a test or interview, and finally document verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Senior Cyber Security Consultant position at IIT Madras is a contract-based job.

faq.question: Q9. Does IIT Madras provide age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limits or relaxation details for this particular post.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section on this page. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.
